# QUESTIONS — Reyes 2025 engagement

Each question states what it changes. The return is prepared under stated assumptions meanwhile.

**Q1 — Leo's 2025 dependency.** Has Elena executed Form 8332 for 2025 (odd year → Father's year under
custody decree ¶9), and will the father actually claim Leo on his 2025 return? *If Elena claims Leo
after all, the CTC rises from $2,200 to $4,400 (refund $2,322 → $4,522) — nothing else changes.*

**Q2 — Prior-year S-corp basis.** Can you provide the 2021–2024 filed Forms 7203 (or the 2024 return)?
I rolled stock basis to $11,500 from Marcus's note. *Any suspended loss carried in from a prior year,
or a basis misstated in the note, changes the $11,500 allowed / $16,500 suspended split, and cascades
into MAGI, the rental allowance, AGI, tax, and the 8962 band.*

**Q3 — Brooklyn lease (largest swing item).** Please provide the current lease (it was noted as
"attached in prior-year file," not in this file), and confirm: (a) the tenant is unrelated to both
spouses and has no other relationship with you; (b) the $1,500/month is the contractual rent under
that written lease and was simply never raised; (c) there is no side agreement, free rent, or services
in exchange. *The library's §280A(d)(2)(C) rule denies ALL rental loss if the dwelling is rented below
fair rental value, with a carve-out for never-raised rent to an unrelated tenant "if the rent is a fair
rental for that lease." If the carve-out doesn't fit, the $19,550 allowed loss evaporates: AGI → $110,900,
taxable income → $79,400 (outside our tax-table excerpt), and the 8962 repayment rises to the $3,150 cap.*

**Q4 — Remote-work status.** Did either employer *require* out-of-state work (employer necessity), or
is the Florida remoteness purely the employees' own convenience? Any letters/agreements? The email reads
as convenience ("he just works remotely now," "Halvorsen let me go fully remote"). *If an employer
required it, those post-move wages escape the convenience-of-the-employer rule and NY wages drop to the
resident-period shares (~$33,699 Marcus / ~$26,762 Elena), materially increasing the IT-203 refund. No
federal effect either way.*

**Q5 — Exact move/residency facts.** Did you keep keys to, or the ability to occupy, the Brooklyn
apartment after June 30? When exactly did you leave Queens (mother's) for Florida — you closed in Tampa
July 3? *I used June 30 as the residency end (181 NY resident days); the alternative is July 3 (184
days). Immaterial to wages under the convenience rule; relevant only to the day-ratio and any NY-day
audit question.*

**Q6 — Health coverage after June.** Elena's W-2 shows employer coverage from July (box 12 DD $7,140).
Please confirm that Marketplace coverage (1095-A, Jan–Jun) ended for ALL FOUR individuals at the end of
June and nobody re-enrolled mid-year on a different policy. *If anyone had additional Marketplace
months, the 8962 needs their 1095-A data. No other coverage consequence is computed — the library has no
individual-mandate or employer-coverage rules.*

**Q7 — Tampa property tax & itemizing (low priority).** What was the 2025 Tampa real property tax
bill? *Used only to confirm itemizing loses: with $6,480 mortgage interest and a $31,500 standard
deduction, you'd need ~$25,000 of other Schedule A deductions. I expect to confirm the standard
deduction regardless.*
